label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter 2)
summary: Iter-2 fixes driven by iter-1 feedback: preflight annotation on Sensor.SAFE_LARGE_DISTANCE; autonomous transitions gated on a new tick input event with mutual-exclusion negations between differently-targeted guards (Dafny postcondition preemption fix).

issues.title: Added a tick input event not present in LRE-DM6
issues.raw: Autonomous (guard-only) transitions are now gated on 'event instanceof InputEvent.tick'. The Dafny generator emits autonomous guards as unconditional postconditions, which higher-priority event branches (endTask, reqHCM, reqOCM) preempt; gating on tick makes the generated premise event-specific. tick models the periodic control cycle and is not an operator command, so LRE-DM6 is unchanged in spirit.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm tick as the control-cycle event; if undesired, the Dafny generator would need to encode if-else priority in its ensures premises instead.

issues.title: Explicit mutual-exclusion negations between differently-targeted autonomous guards
issues.raw: Added !inOpez / !camCondition conjuncts (camCondition = cdaBelowMinSafeDist && tcpaNonNegative) to lower-priority autonomous transitions whose targets differ, making Java else-if priority explicit in each guard. Redundant in Java; required for provable Dafny postconditions and exact RoboChart guard semantics. Same-target overlaps (the three MOM->HCM guards) carry no cross negations.

issues.title: CAM has no defined entry action (carried from iter 1)
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 says CAM 'performs evasive manoeuvres' but no requirement specifies a CAM entry output.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm whether entering CAM should emit an advVel/advHdng output.

issues.title: CPA math (carried from iter 1)
issues.raw: 2D horizontal CPA; tcpa=-1.0 and cda=hdist(cdyn) when relative speed is zero.
issues.fix_directive: Review if CAM behaviour looks wrong under verification.
